mapper.sql: mid, username, password, company_name, contact_person, contact_phone, email, address, business_license, business_hours, facilities, detail_intro, videos, rules, venue_photos, is_submitted, pending_data, status, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO merchant (username, password, company_name, contact_person, contact_phone, email, address, business_license, business_hours, facilities, detail_intro, videos, rules, venue_photos, is_submitted, pending_data, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{companyName}, #{contactPerson}, #{contactPhone}, #{email}, #{address}, #{businessLicense}, #{businessHours}, #{facilities}, #{detailIntro}, #{videos}, #{rules}, #{venuePhotos}, #{isSubmitted}, #{pendingData}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE merchant SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE mid = #{mid}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM merchant WHERE status = #{status} AND is_submitted = #{isSubmitted} ORDER BY create_time DESC
